title: MEIDNet: pretrained Perov-5 models for inverse materials design
subtitle: Multimodal structure-property latent space for cubic ABX3 perovskites (npj Comput. Mater. 2026)
description: Three pretrained MEIDNet checkpoints (PyTorch, 2.8 MB each), the configuration and the family file that reproduce the Perov-5 experiment of the paper, and 26 candidate CIFs. Use them with the open-source package: pip install git+https://github.com/ABnano/MEIDNet.git. Live platform: https://babu09-meidnet.hf.space/. Paper: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41524-026-02153-3

resources.description: production model of the paper (early fusion, property-aware decoding, 2000 epochs)
